# Built-in procs and types

Procs, types, constants and context fields that exist without a declaration.

## Procs

### `abs`

```odin
abs :: proc(v: T) -> T
```

Absolute value.

### `align_of`

```odin
align_of :: proc($T: typeid) -> int
```

Alignment of a type in bytes.

### `append`

```odin
append :: proc(array: ^[dynamic]$E, args: ..E) -> int
```

Appends to a dynamic array, growing it as needed.

### `assert`

```odin
assert :: proc(cond: bool, message := "")
```

Panics when the condition is false (unless asserts are disabled).

### `assign_at`

```odin
assign_at :: proc(array: ^[dynamic]$E, index: int, arg: E)
```

Sets an element, growing the array if needed.

### `cap`

```odin
cap :: proc(v: $T) -> int
```

Capacity of a dynamic array or map.

### `card`

```odin
card :: proc(s: bit_set) -> int
```

Number of members in a bit_set.

### `clamp`

```odin
clamp :: proc(v, lo, hi: T) -> T
```

`v` limited to `lo..=hi`.

### `clear`

```odin
clear :: proc(v: ^$T)
```

Empties a dynamic array or map, keeping its memory.

### `conj`

```odin
conj :: proc(z: complex) -> complex
```

Complex conjugate.

### `copy`

```odin
copy :: proc(dst, src: []$E) -> int
```

Copies elements between slices; returns how many.

### `delete`

```odin
delete :: proc(v: $T, allocator := context.allocator)
```

Frees a string, slice, dynamic array or map.

### `delete_key`

```odin
delete_key :: proc(m: ^map[$K]$V, key: K) -> (K, V)
```

Removes a key from a map.

### `expand_values`

```odin
expand_values :: proc(s: struct or array) -> (..)
```

Spreads a struct's fields or an array's elements as multiple values.

### `free`

```odin
free :: proc(ptr: rawptr, allocator := context.allocator)
```

Frees memory allocated with `new`.

### `free_all`

```odin
free_all :: proc(allocator := context.allocator)
```

Frees everything an allocator owns.

### `imag`

```odin
imag :: proc(z: complex) -> float
```

Imaginary part of a complex number.

### `inject_at`

```odin
inject_at :: proc(array: ^[dynamic]$E, index: int, arg: E)
```

Inserts into a dynamic array.

### `len`

```odin
len :: proc(v: $T) -> int
```

Number of elements of an array, slice, dynamic array, map or string (bytes for strings).

### `make`

```odin
make :: proc($T: typeid, args: ..int, allocator := context.allocator) -> T
```

Allocates a slice, dynamic array or map.

### `max`

```odin
max :: proc(values: ..T) -> T
```

The largest of its arguments.

### `min`

```odin
min :: proc(values: ..T) -> T
```

The smallest of its arguments.

### `new`

```odin
new :: proc($T: typeid, allocator := context.allocator) -> ^T
```

Allocates a zeroed value and returns a pointer to it.

### `new_clone`

```odin
new_clone :: proc(value: $T, allocator := context.allocator) -> ^T
```

Allocates a copy of a value and returns a pointer to it.

### `offset_of`

```odin
offset_of :: proc($T: typeid, field) -> uintptr
```

Byte offset of a struct field.

### `ordered_remove`

```odin
ordered_remove :: proc(array: ^[dynamic]$E, index: int)
```

Removes an element, keeping the order.

### `panic`

```odin
panic :: proc(message: string) -> !
```

Stops the program with a message.

### `pop`

```odin
pop :: proc(array: ^[dynamic]$E) -> E
```

Removes and returns the last element.

### `pop_front`

```odin
pop_front :: proc(array: ^[dynamic]$E) -> E
```

Removes and returns the first element.

### `raw_data`

```odin
raw_data :: proc(v: $T) -> [^]E
```

A pointer to the first element of a slice, array or string.

### `real`

```odin
real :: proc(z: complex) -> float
```

Real part of a complex number.

### `remove_range`

```odin
remove_range :: proc(array: ^[dynamic]$E, lo, hi: int)
```

Removes a range of elements.

### `reserve`

```odin
reserve :: proc(v: ^$T, capacity: int)
```

Grows the capacity of a dynamic array or map.

### `resize`

```odin
resize :: proc(array: ^[dynamic]$E, length: int)
```

Sets the length of a dynamic array.

### `shrink`

```odin
shrink :: proc(v: ^$T)
```

Frees unused capacity.

### `size_of`

```odin
size_of :: proc($T: typeid) -> int
```

Size of a type in bytes.

### `swizzle`

```odin
swizzle :: proc(v: [N]T, indices: ..int) -> [len(indices)]T
```

Rearranges the elements of an array.

### `type_info_of`

```odin
type_info_of :: proc($T: typeid) -> ^runtime.Type_Info
```

Runtime type information.

### `type_of`

```odin
type_of :: proc(x: expr) -> type
```

The type of an expression.

### `typeid_of`

```odin
typeid_of :: proc($T: typeid) -> typeid
```

The `typeid` of a type.

### `unimplemented`

```odin
unimplemented :: proc(message := "") -> !
```

Panics: this code is not written yet.

### `unordered_remove`

```odin
unordered_remove :: proc(array: ^[dynamic]$E, index: int)
```

Removes an element by swapping the last one in.

## Types

- `any`: Any value, as a pointer to its data and its `typeid`.
- `b16`: 16-bit boolean.
- `b32`: 32-bit boolean.
- `b64`: 64-bit boolean.
- `b8`: 8-bit boolean.
- `bool`: Boolean (1 byte).
- `byte`: Alias of `u8`.
- `complex128`: Complex number of two `f64`.
- `complex64`: Complex number of two `f32`.
- `cstring`: Null-terminated C string.
- `f16`: 16-bit float.
- `f32`: 32-bit float.
- `f64`: 64-bit float.
- `i128`: 128-bit signed integer.
- `i16`: 16-bit signed integer.
- `i32`: 32-bit signed integer.
- `i64`: 64-bit signed integer.
- `i8`: 8-bit signed integer.
- `int`: Signed integer of pointer size (64-bit on 64-bit targets).
- `Pool`: Vidar: `Pool(I)` holds values of every implementation of interface `I`, one array per type. `for s in pool` loops over each type in turn with `s: ^T`, so method calls are direct. Supports `append` (values), `len`, `clear` and `delete`.
- `quaternion256`: Quaternion of four `f64`.
- `rawptr`: Untyped pointer (`void*`).
- `rune`: A Unicode code point (32-bit).
- `string`: UTF-8 string: a pointer and a byte length. Not null-terminated.
- `u128`: 128-bit unsigned integer.
- `u16`: 16-bit unsigned integer.
- `u32`: 32-bit unsigned integer.
- `u64`: 64-bit unsigned integer.
- `u8`: 8-bit unsigned integer.
- `uint`: Unsigned integer of pointer size.
- `uintptr`: Unsigned integer large enough to hold a pointer.

## Constants

### `ODIN_ARCH`

```odin
ODIN_ARCH: runtime.Odin_Arch_Type
```

The target architecture (`.amd64`, `.arm64`, ...).

### `ODIN_ARCH_STRING`

```odin
ODIN_ARCH_STRING: string
```

The target architecture, as a string.

### `ODIN_BUILD_MODE`

```odin
ODIN_BUILD_MODE: runtime.Odin_Build_Mode_Type
```

The `-build-mode:` (exe, dll, obj, ...).

### `ODIN_DEBUG`

```odin
ODIN_DEBUG: bool
```

Whether compiling with `-debug`.

### `ODIN_DISABLE_ASSERT`

```odin
ODIN_DISABLE_ASSERT: bool
```

Whether `assert` is compiled out.

### `ODIN_ENDIAN`

```odin
ODIN_ENDIAN: runtime.Odin_Endian_Type
```

The target byte order.

### `ODIN_OPTIMIZATION_MODE`

```odin
ODIN_OPTIMIZATION_MODE: runtime.Odin_Optimization_Mode
```

The `-o:` optimization mode.

### `ODIN_OS`

```odin
ODIN_OS: runtime.Odin_OS_Type
```

The target operating system (`.Darwin`, `.Linux`, `.Windows`, ...).

### `ODIN_OS_STRING`

```odin
ODIN_OS_STRING: string
```

The target operating system, as a string.

### `ODIN_ROOT`

```odin
ODIN_ROOT: string
```

The Odin installation directory.

### `ODIN_VERSION`

```odin
ODIN_VERSION: string
```

The compiler version.

## Context fields

### `allocator`

```odin
allocator: runtime.Allocator
```

The default allocator for `new`, `make`, `append`, ...

### `assertion_failure_proc`

```odin
assertion_failure_proc: runtime.Assertion_Failure_Proc
```

Called when an assertion fails.

### `logger`

```odin
logger: runtime.Logger
```

The logger used by `core:log`.

### `random_generator`

```odin
random_generator: runtime.Random_Generator
```

The generator used by `core:math/rand`.

### `temp_allocator`

```odin
temp_allocator: runtime.Allocator
```

The temporary (arena) allocator, freed with `free_all(context.temp_allocator)`.

### `user_index`

```odin
user_index: int
```

Free for the program's own use.

### `user_ptr`

```odin
user_ptr: rawptr
```

Free for the program's own use.
